name: Vendors Stories for Dokan
author: ARZWP

sections.description:
Vendors Stories for Dokan adds an Instagram-style “Stories” feature to your Dokan powered multivendor marketplace.

Vendors can publish photo stories with an optional button link. Stories appear automatically on every vendor’s store page with a beautiful Instagram-style viewer. Vendors can add multiple photo slides in a single submission, publish as many stories as they want, and toggle visibility or delete their own stories from the Dokan dashboard.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Dokan or weDevs teams. It is an independent plugin that integrates with the Dokan plugin through its documented hooks.

Features

  • Each vendor can publish photo stories with an optional custom button link and button text.
  • Unlimited stories per vendor — publish as many stories as you want.
  • Multi-slide batches — vendors add several story slides in a single submission.
  • Instagram-style story viewer (Zuck.js / Snapgram) on vendor store pages.
  • Vendors can toggle story visibility or delete their own stories from the Dokan dashboard.
  • Secure: media URLs are validated against the site’s own media library and attachment MIME types are whitelisted.

PRO version

This free plugin is fully functional on its own — nothing in it is locked or limited. If you need even more, a separate PRO plugin is available: Vendors Stories for Dokan PRO.

The separate PRO plugin adds:

  • Video stories (MP4, WebM, MOV, OGG).
  • A [dokan_vendors_stories] shortcode to display a combined story ring of all vendors on any page or post.
  • An admin stories management screen (view, preview, activate/deactivate, bulk delete).
  • Priority support.

Video introduction

Included third-party library

This plugin bundles the Zuck.js JavaScript library by Ramon Sampaio, released under the MIT license. Zuck.js is compatible with the GPLv2 or later license under which this plugin is distributed. The bundled snapgram.min.css skin is also part of Zuck.js and shares its MIT license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vendors-stories-for-dokan directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Make sure the Dokan Lite plugin is installed and activated.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Vendors will find a “My Stories” menu in their Dokan dashboard.
  5. Stories automatically appear on each vendor’s store page.
